question: In June 2020, Amit Panghal and Vikas Krishan were nominated for ________ by the Boxing Federation of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award**__.

__
 
• **In June 2020, Boxing Federation of India has nominated Amit Panghal and Vikas Krishan for the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna award**__.

 __
 
• Amit Panghal (52kg), also an Asian Games champion, has not won any national sports award.
 
• Commonwealth and Asian Games gold-medallist Vikas Krishan won the **Arjuna award in 2012**.
 
• BFI: Headquarters - New Delhi.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Padma Bhushan** is the third highest civilian award in the Republic of India, preceded by the **Bharat Ratna and Padma Vibhushan and followed by the Padma Shri**.

 
 
• Established on **2 January 1954**, the award is given for "distinguished service of a high order without distinction of race, occupation, status or sex".
 
• The award criteria include "service in any field including service rendered by government servants" including doctors and scientists, but excludes those working with public sector undertakings. 
 
 
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award**, formerly known as Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award in sports and games, is India's highest sporting honor.
 
 
• It is awarded annually by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**. 
 
 
 
• **Padma Shri** is the fourth highest civilian award of the Republic of India after **Bharat Ratna, Padma Vibhushan, and Padma Bhushan**.
 
 
• It is provided by the Government of India every year on the Republic Day of India.
 
 
 
• **Arjuna Award**, officially known as the Arjuna Award for outstanding performance in sports and games, is India's second-highest sports honor.
 
 
• The award is named after Arjuna, one of the characters from the Sanskrit epic Mahabharata of ancient India.
